project.name: waydroid-apps
project.description: Declarative, data-driven provisioning of a curated Android app set into the local Waydroid (LineageOS) container, plus a fully data-driven launcher layout (hotseat 'bottom bar' + home-screen workspace + folders) and theme (dark mode + generated dark wallpaper). Apps are pinned in src/apps.lock.json (F-Droid suggestedVersionCode + nix-prefetched sha256), fetched reproducibly by src/flake.nix, installed with `waydroid app install`. The launcher layout is rendered from the `launcher` block below into Launcher3's `favorites` DB by the engine (folders=itemType 2, hotseat=container -101, workspace=container -100). NOTHING is hardcoded in the engine: app list, layout, folders, theme, F-Droid endpoints, Waydroid data roots and the launcher DB are all read from this file or discovered at runtime (the DB filename is grid-dependent, e.g. launcher_6_by_5.db, so it is globbed).

waydroid._doc: Host-side facts. data_roots is a candidate list; the engine picks the first that exists. launcher_db_glob is grid-dependent (launcher_<cols>_by_<rows>.db) so it MUST be globbed. Containers/itemTypes are AOSP Launcher3 constants. media_subdir is where the container's /sdcard lives on the host (used to stage the wallpaper).
waydroid._doc_install: `waydroid app install` is unreliable (silently no-ops, esp. for larger APKs — Organic Maps 72MB failed). The engine installs robustly by staging the APK into the container's tmp (container_tmp ↔ host <data_root>/local/tmp) and running `pm install -r -d`.

launcher._doc: Data-driven Launcher3 layout. `folders` are reusable group definitions (members = package ids). `hotseat` is the bottom bar, left→right (ref = a package id or 'folder:<id>'). `workspace` is the home screen: screen 0, each cell placed at (cellX,cellY) on a 6-column grid; ref = package id or 'folder:<id>'. A folder ref placed in both hotseat and workspace yields two independent folder instances with the same title+members. Re-arrange by editing here + `build.sh layout` — no code changes.

theme._doc: dark_mode toggles Android night UI (cmd uimode night). wallpaper is generated by build.sh (ImageMagick from the flake devShell) as a dark vertical gradient and set via `cmd wallpaper`. Colors/size are data-driven. auto_rotate sets system accelerometer_rotation=1 so the screen follows the da_waydroid-sensors accelerometer HAL.
